**Kijumo Community Health Link (KCHL)** — *We Care, God Cures* — is hiring an **Enrolled Nurse (1 position)** for its facility in **Ishaka/Bushenyi Municipality**.

## About KCHL

Kijumo Community Health Link is a community-rooted health facility serving the Ishaka and Bushenyi municipality area. True to its motto "We Care, God Cures", the team combines compassionate, hands-on nursing care with strong community ties — which is why fluency in Runyankole is a must for every role here.

## The role

As Enrolled Nurse you will be on the front line of day-to-day patient care: taking vitals, administering treatment as prescribed, dressing wounds, monitoring admitted patients and supporting the wider clinical team during busy outpatient sessions. This is an ideal opening for a recent graduate looking to build solid hands-on experience close to home.

## Requirements

- Enrolled Nurse qualification from a recognized institution
- Fresh graduates up to two years of experience only need apply
- Must speak and understand **Runyankole**
- Willing to work in Ishaka/Bushenyi Municipality

## Remuneration

- Salary: to be discussed at interview
- Daily allowance: UGX 3,000
- Lunch provided

## How to apply

Send your CV, cover letter and academic documents by **28 August 2026**:

1. Email: **kijumochlink@gmail.com**
2. WhatsApp: **0756 364 585** *(WhatsApp only)*

> Note: Never pay money for a job opportunity or recruitment process.
